title: Lesson — 17 November
description: Your words for 17 November: phrasal verbs for everyday life, and words and phrases for giving opinions and sounding natural in conversation.

items.definition: to understand something or find the answer to a problem after thinking about it
items.example: It took me an hour to [figure out] how the new coffee machine works.
items.exampleRu: Мне понадобился час, чтобы разобраться, как работает новая кофемашина.
items.pattern: figure out how/what/why… · figure it out (pronoun in the middle)
items.trap: With a pronoun say 'figure it out', not 'figure out it'.

items.definition: to trust someone or something to help you or to work as you need
items.example: You can always [rely on] Anna: she has never missed a deadline.
items.exampleRu: На Анну всегда можно положиться: она ни разу не сорвала сроки.
collocations: rely on sb to do sth
items.pattern: rely on sb/sth · rely on sb to do sth
items.trap: The preposition is 'on', not 'to' or 'at': «полагаться на» = rely on.

items.definition: to become familiar with something new so that it no longer feels strange or difficult
items.example: At first the cold was hard, but after a month I [got used to] it.
items.exampleRu: Сначала было тяжело из-за холода, но через месяц я к нему привык.
collocations: get used to a new job
items.trap: After 'get used to' use -ing: 'get used to waking up early', not 'get used to wake up'. 'I used to…' (раньше я…) is a different phrase.

items.definition: to delay doing something until a later time, often because you don't want to do it
items.example: I keep [putting off] my dentist appointment because I hate needles.
items.exampleRu: Я всё откладываю визит к стоматологу, потому что терпеть не могу уколы.
items.pattern: put off doing sth · put it off (pronoun in the middle)
items.trap: Followed by -ing, not 'to': 'put off calling', not 'put off to call'.

items.definition: to feel happy and excited about something that is going to happen
items.example: I'm really [looking forward to] our holiday in Portugal next month.
items.exampleRu: Я с нетерпением жду нашего отпуска в Португалии в следующем месяце.
collocations: look forward to hearing from you
items.trap: 'To' is a preposition here: 'look forward to seeing you', not 'look forward to see you'.

items.definition: to check that something is true or done, or to take action so that it happens
items.example: Before you leave, [make sure] all the windows are closed.
items.exampleRu: Перед уходом убедись, что все окна закрыты.
items.pattern: make sure (that) + clause · make sure to + verb
items.trap: Not 'do sure' or 'make sure in': «убедиться в чём-то» = make sure of sth / make sure that…

items.example: It was [obvious] from his face that he hadn't slept all night.
items.exampleRu: По его лицу было очевидно, что он не спал всю ночь.
items.trap: Spelling: one 'b', and the ending is -ious: o-b-v-i-o-u-s.

items.example: The flight takes [roughly] three hours, depending on the wind.
items.exampleRu: Полёт длится примерно три часа, в зависимости от ветра.
items.trap: Pronounced /ˈrʌfli/, like 'ruff-ly'; the 'gh' sounds like 'f'. Also means 'грубо' (treat sb roughly).

items.definition: used when you have heard something but are not sure it is true, or when something seems true
items.example: [Apparently], the new boss used to work for Google.
items.exampleRu: Говорят, новый начальник раньше работал в Google.
items.trap: False friend: it doesn't mean «очевидно» (that's 'obviously'). 'Apparently' = «судя по всему, как я слышал».

items.definition: used to say that you think something is true but you are not completely sure
items.example: [As far as I know], the meeting is still on for Friday.
items.exampleRu: Насколько я знаю, встреча в пятницу всё ещё в силе.
collocations: as far as I can tell
items.pattern: As far as I know, + sentence
items.trap: Not 'as much as I know' or 'how far I know': the fixed form is 'as far as'.

items.translation: с точки зрения, в плане, что касается
items.definition: used to say which aspect of something you are talking about
items.example: [In terms of] salary the job is great, but the hours are long.
items.exampleRu: В плане зарплаты работа отличная, но рабочий день длинный.
items.trap: Always plural 'terms' and 'of': not 'in term of' or 'in terms on'.

items.definition: used before saying what you really think, especially something negative
items.example: [To be honest], I didn't really enjoy the film.
items.exampleRu: Если честно, фильм мне не особо понравился.
items.trap: Not 'if to be honest' (a calque of «если честно»). The 'h' is silent: /ˈɒnɪst/.
